core.name: mroffice-core
core.description: The shared layer of the MR Office editors (the host adapter, ribbon, fonts and text measurement, themes, charts, SmartArt, equations); every editor package uses it.

docs.name: mroffice-docs
docs.label: document editor
docs.description: The MR Office document editor for React: a paged word processor with an Office-style ribbon, in the browser.

sheets.name: mroffice-sheets
sheets.label: spreadsheet editor
sheets.description: The MR Office spreadsheet editor for React: formulas, number formats, cell styles, tables, charts, many sheets, in the browser.
sheets.saves: .mrsheet, or CSV/TSV for a CSV/TSV file

slides.name: mroffice-slides
slides.label: presentation editor
slides.description: The MR Office presentation editor for React: slides with themes, layouts, shapes, tables, charts and SmartArt, in the browser.

pdf.name: mroffice-pdf
pdf.label: PDF editor
pdf.description: The MR Office PDF viewer for React: pages, thumbnails, search, presenting and comments, in the browser.
pdf.saves: the PDF as it was opened (comments stay in the page)

code.name: mroffice-code
code.label: code editor
code.description: The MR Office code editor for React: CodeMirror 6 with an Office-style ribbon, outline, quick open, find and problems, in the browser.

assets.name: mroffice-assets
assets.description: The files the MR Office editors fetch on demand (fonts, the PDF worker and its data, spelling dictionaries, code runners, interface text): served from a CDN, or copied to a site that hosts them itself. Not a dependency to import.
